title: 第142章 惊雷刀谱第141章 十万功勋
lines: “……”纳兰雪见楚生这反应，不禁暗想：“莫非他一开始就是想要这个？”
“算了，总归了却心事，便能安心修炼了！”
纳兰雪取出腰牌，将功勋转给楚生后，便驾驭飞舟离开了。
楚生挥了挥手道别。
纳兰雪彻底不见后，楚生才激动道：“不愧是锻骨境的弟子，真他娘豪啊！
十万功勋说给就给了，这条命救得值啊！
有了这十万功勋，我便可以去功勋殿兑换玄阶功法了。”
的确如纳兰雪所想的一样，功勋殿内的玄阶功法，楚生惦念已久了。
奈何三个月下来，楚生自己接任务赚取的功勋，加上考核时赚的，一共才一万功勋。
而玄阶初级功法，则需要十万功勋才能兑换。
等级更高的，则需要更多的功勋。
这些，根本不是楚生一个新学员敢想的。
黄昏前夕，赵琴找到楚生的院子，问道：
“楚生，你要参加雷渊秘境试炼吗？”
“嗯嗯，是的。”楚生点头回应道，“你呢？”
“纳兰师姐说那里十分危险，我才炼肉境初阶，哪怕是秘境外围，同样可能小命不保。”赵琴语气低沉，道，
“这一次，我就不去了，我在外院潜修。”
楚生点点头，道：“这样也好。”
赵琴走上前，靠近楚生，担忧道：“你注意安全，要活着回来。”
“好！”楚生一把抱住赵琴，将其放到软榻上，共同研习武道。
一夜探讨，二人不时兵刃对练，在这独院中擦出闪耀花火。
次日，楚生准备前往功勋殿。
赵琴同样起床，紧随其后，提醒道：
“江涛到时也会参加雷渊秘境试炼，你到时可以和他一起组队。”
“嗯。”楚生应道。
二人在离开东侧宿舍区域后，便分道扬镳。
楚生独自前往功勋殿，寻找合适的功法进行兑换。
《断岳刀诀》玄阶初级，火属性。
一刀出，山岳断。
配套武技，《断岳三式》：第一式·裂地，第二式·崩山，第三式·断岳。
《惊雷刀谱》玄阶初级，雷属性。
刀出如雷，一击必杀。
配套武技，《惊雷三闪》：第一闪·电光，第二闪·霹雳，第三闪·惊雷。
楚生挑选了《惊雷刀谱》，去找功勋殿执事兑换。
在对方懵逼的状态下，楚生交出十万功勋，获得了玄阶功法《惊雷刀谱》。
一个入学院仅三月的学员，耗费十万功勋，兑换玄阶功法。
这让功勋殿执事都被震惊了。
楚生哪管这么多，回到院子，就开始摸索起来。
选择《惊雷刀谱》，楚生有着自己的想法。
content_en:
"..." Seeing Chu Sheng's reaction, Nalan Xue couldn't help but think to herself: "Did he want this from the beginning?"
"Forget it, now that I have settled my worries, I can practice with peace of mind!"
Nalan Xue took out her waist badge, transferred the merit to Chu Sheng, and then left in the flying boat.
Chu Sheng waved goodbye.
After Nalan Xue disappeared completely, Chu Shengcai said excitedly: "As expected of a disciple of the Bone Forging Realm, you are so damn powerful!
One hundred thousand meritorious deeds are given as soon as they are given. This life is worth saving!
With these 100,000 meritorious deeds, I can go to the meritorious merit hall to exchange for Xuanjie skills. "
Indeed, as Nalan Xue thought, Chu Sheng had been thinking about the Xuanjie Kung Fu in the Hall of Merit for a long time.
However, after three months, Chu Sheng earned only 10,000 merit points from taking on the missions, plus the merit points he earned during the assessment.
The Xuan level primary skills require one hundred thousand meritorious deeds to redeem.
Higher levels require more meritorious deeds.
These are not things Chu Sheng, a new student, dares to think about.
On the eve of dusk, Zhao Qin found Chu Sheng’s yard and asked:
"Chu Sheng, do you want to participate in the trial of the Thunder Abyss Secret Realm?"
"Yeah, yes." Chu Sheng nodded and responded, "What about you?"
"Senior Sister Nalan said it is very dangerous there. I am only at the beginning of the Flesh Refining Realm. Even if I am outside the secret realm, my life may be in danger." Zhao Qin said in a low tone,
"This time, I won't go. I will cultivate in the outer courtyard."
Chu Sheng nodded and said, "That's fine."
Zhao Qin stepped forward, approached Chu Sheng, and said worriedly: "Please pay attention to safety and come back alive."
"Okay!" Chu Sheng hugged Zhao Qin and put him on the soft couch to study martial arts together.
After discussing all night, the two continued to practice swordsmanship, sparking sparks in this private courtyard.
The next day, Chu Sheng prepared to go to the Hall of Merit.
Zhao Qin also got up, followed closely, and reminded:
"Jiang Tao will also participate in the Thunder Abyss Secret Realm trial. You can form a team with him then."
"Yeah." Chu Sheng responded.
After the two left the dormitory area on the east side, they went their separate ways.
Chu Sheng went to the Hall of Merit alone to look for suitable skills to redeem.
"The Yue-Breaking Sword Technique" is the elementary level of Xuan level, with fire attribute.
With one strike of the knife, the mountain was cut off.
The accompanying martial arts are "Three Forms of Breaking the Mountain": the first form: cracking the ground, the second form: collapsing the mountain, and the third form: breaking the mountain.
"Thunder Blade Book" Xuan level primary level, thunder attribute.
The sword shoots out like thunder and kills with one strike.
Matching martial arts, "Three Flashes of Thunder": the first flash is lightning, the second flash is thunderbolt, and the third flash is thunder.
…
Chu Sheng chose the "Thunder Sword Manual" and went to the deacon of the Hall of Merit to redeem it.
While the opponent was in a state of confusion, Chu Sheng handed over 100,000 meritorious deeds and obtained the mysterious level skill "Thunder Blade Manual".
A student who has only been in the academy for three months has spent 100,000 merit points to exchange for the Xuanjie Kung Fu.
This shocked the deacons of the Hall of Merit.
Chu Sheng didn't care so much. When he returned to the yard, he started to explore.
Choosing "Thunder Blade Book", Chu Sheng had his own ideas.
title_en: Chapter 142 Thunder Blade Book Chapter 141 One Hundred Thousand Merits
